diagram_math_checks.local_basis: Affine reflection definition r_alpha,k(x)=x-(B(x,alpha)-k)alpha^vee; local panel equivariance in lem-cg-affine-alcove-separation-and-facet-types; Fact F7 and Verification 4.1
checks: At v1, the pairings with alpha2,alpha1,theta are 0,1,1. Thus the three incident walls have local directions 30/210,90/270,150/330 degrees, respectively. There are exactly six rays and six 60-degree sectors in the rendered inset.

The shaded fundamental sector is between rays 150 and 210 degrees. Its boundary labels are 0 and 2; proceeding counterclockwise from 30 degrees gives labels 0,2,0,2,0,2. These are ray-panel labels; they are not whole-wall labels or sector labels.

Translation to v1 turns the affine reflections into orthogonal line reflections. Reflection in H_alpha2,0 (axis 30 degrees) sends the fundamental 150-degree type-0 ray to the 270-degree type-0 ray and fixes the 210-degree type-2 ray. Reflection in H_theta,1 (axis 150 degrees) sends the 210-degree type-2 ray to the 90-degree type-2 ray and fixes the 150-degree type-0 ray. Repeating this action gives the remaining alternating labels, in agreement with local type equivariance and the order-three rotation.

The H_theta,1 ray toward v2 has direction 150 degrees/type 0, while its opposite ray at 330 degrees has type 2, exactly as stated. The inset is explicitly magnified; it is not presented at the triangle figure's unit scale.
